title: Bawbawgyi Pagoda, Sri Ksetra
summary: Bawbawgyi is a cylindrical brick stupa at Sri Ksetra, a Pyu city in Myanmar, rising about 46 metres (153 feet) above five low circular terraces. It stands roughly 250 metres south of the old city wall. Scholars date it to the 6th–7th centuries CE and class it among the free-standing stupas of the mature Pyu phase.

uncertainty.note: Sources give "6th-7th century" (Go Myanmar Tours) and "sixth–seventh century" (Murphy and Lefferts); start is the first year of the 6th century and the range runs to 700 CE. End is the present: the stupa still stands.
